locator.title: Как сейчас говорить с аудиторией, чтобы у вас покупали
locator.lead: Разбираем, как удержать внимание, вызвать доверие и подвести человека к покупке
locator.caption: Вы получаете несколько минут на разговор с аудиторией, которой потенциально интересно предложение, и платите за тех, кто дочитал материал или перешел на сайт

nearest_text_before.text: Долгий контакт начинается с заинтересованности самого человека: он видит заголовок в РСЯ или на Поиске и открывает материал, если тема ему близка. Найти больше потенциальных читателей помогают таргетинги по интересам и сегментам Яндекс Аудиторий, а авто look-alike подбирает пользователей, похожих на тех, кто уже прочитал статью.

image_reading: A woman sits at a desk with an open laptop, looking slightly off to her left with a soft, composed smile.
Her hands rest on the keyboard; the bright home-office setting, mug, notebook and lamp support a calm, focused work moment.
The woman and laptop remain clearly visible in a wide, stable composition.
analysis.article_context: Body image illustrating the article’s point that PromoPages create a calm, sustained conversation with an interested audience: a person is thoughtfully working on content rather than reacting to a hard sell.

structured_intent.editorial_meaning: A useful advertising article earns attention through a calm, relevant conversation with a genuinely interested person.
structured_intent.primary_action: The woman shifts her attention from offscreen to her laptop.
structured_intent.terminal_state: The woman’s gaze is settled on the laptop screen while her gentle smile remains.
structured_intent.semantic_invariant: Her composed, approachable engagement remains unchanged through the final frame.

models.scene_plan: Over five seconds, the woman begins shifting her attention from the side toward the laptop immediately and completes the small head-and-eye turn at an unhurried pace. The camera stays fixed on her and the laptop; her expression remains quietly engaged. In the final moments, her gaze is settled on the screen, with only a natural residual stillness.
models.positive_prompt: Fixed camera. The woman slowly turns her gaze from the side back to her laptop in one calm, attentive motion, ending focused on the screen with her soft smile intact.

models.scene_plan: For this five-second shot, use a smooth, moderate shift of the woman’s head and eyes toward the laptop, developing through most of the duration. Keep the composition fixed and let the relaxed smile hold throughout. The readable endpoint near the end is her attention fully returned to the screen.
models.positive_prompt: With a fixed camera, she gradually brings her attention from offscreen to the laptop, ending with a calm, engaged gaze settled on the screen and the same gentle smile.

models.scene_plan: Across four seconds, the woman makes one concise, natural attention shift toward the laptop. Keep the camera fixed; the movement is steady and modest, without gestures or speech. By the last frame, she is clearly looking at the screen with the same composed, approachable expression.
models.positive_prompt: Fixed camera on the woman and laptop. She smoothly turns her eyes and head toward the laptop, ending calmly focused on the screen while maintaining her gentle smile.
